source: engine selector: default "mysql" is not the managed PostgreSQL engine — set "pgsql" to use the managed PostgreSQL database

findings.message: This app requires environment variables that have no value yet: DB_CONNECTION, MEILISEARCH_KEY, SCRIBE_AUTH_KEY, TYPESENSE_API_KEY, UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY. Set them in the application's Configuration screen before deploying.
This app uses PostgreSQL but has no migration command; schema updates will not run on deploy.
